tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: Vaspian tenant web name or company phone number (e.g. vaspian or 7169612115). Pre-fills the login form.

dialPrefix.title: Dial prefix
dialPrefix.description: Digit dialed before external numbers: "" (none), "8" or "9". Extensions are never prefixed.

screenPopEnabled.title: Screen pop on
screenPopEnabled.description: Open the caller's record in the CRM when a call comes in.

screenPopTrigger.title: Screen pop trigger
screenPopTrigger.description: "answer" (opens when the agent answers) or "manual" (only when the agent clicks Open on the call card). The older "offer" value is treated as "answer".

screenPopInternal.title: Screen pop for internal callers
screenPopInternal.description: Also pop for calls from coworkers (extensions). Only used with a custom URL that contains {phone} or {name}.

crmPreset.title: CRM
crmPreset.description: "simplicity" (Simplicity Collect), "zoho" (Zoho Desk via the Vaspian screen pop service), "zohocrm" (Zoho CRM, set zohoCrmOrg), "securecrm" (SecureCRM), "googlecontacts" (Google Contacts), "google" (Google search) or "custom".

crmCustomUrl.title: Custom CRM URL
crmCustomUrl.description: Used when crmPreset is "custom". https:// URL with {phone10}, {phone11}, {e164}, {phoneDash}, {phoneParen}, {phone} or {name}.

zohoBaseUrl.title: Zoho Desk screen pop service URL
zohoBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the zoho-screenpop service (default https://zoho-screenpop.vaspian.me/).

zohoKey.title: Zoho Desk screen pop key
zohoKey.description: Shared key of the zoho-screenpop service. Never shown to the user or included in diagnostics.

secureCrmBaseUrl.title: SecureCRM dialer URL
secureCrmBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the SecureCRM dialer page (default https://www.securecrm.io/dialer2.php).

zohoCrmOrg.title: Zoho CRM org ID
zohoCrmOrg.description: Used when crmPreset is "zohocrm": the org number from the Zoho CRM address bar, e.g. "org316075032" or "316075032".

wrapUpEnabled.title: After-call wrap-up
wrapUpEnabled.description: Ask the agent for a disposition and note after each answered call.

dispositions.title: Dispositions
dispositions.description: The disposition choices offered after a call.

locked.title: Locked settings
locked.description: Groups the user cannot change. Without a lock, a managed value is only a default.

screenPop.title: Lock screen pop on/off and trigger
